meta.name: spec-kit-skill
meta.description: GitHub Spec-Kit integration for constitution-based spec-driven development. 7-phase workflow. Triggers: "spec-kit", "speckit", "constitution", "specify", ".specify/", "规格驱动开发", "需求规格".

copy.tagline: 用宪法式规格驱动开发，自动执行7阶段工作流
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果采用规格驱动开发，需要结构化工作流管理
copy.tagline_en: Drive development with constitution-based specs, automate 7-phase workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use spec-driven development and need structured workflow management

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你通过 7 个阶段（宪法、规格、澄清、计划、任务、分析、实现）来开发功能，并在 .specify/specs/ 目录下创建文件。
howto.when: 当你提到“spec-kit”、“specify”、“宪法”、“规格驱动开发”等关键词，或要求进行结构化功能开发时触发。

say.text: 用 spec-kit 开始一个新功能开发。
say.note: Claude 会检查 CLI 并初始化项目。

say.text: 帮我创建项目的宪法文件。
为当前功能生成实现任务。
say.note: Claude 会进入任务阶段并创建 tasks.md。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you through a 7-phase workflow (Constitution, Specify, Clarify, Plan, Tasks, Analyze, Implement) for feature development, creating files in .specify/specs/.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like "spec-kit", "specify", "constitution", "规格驱动开发", or request structured feature development.

say_en.text: Start a new feature development with spec-kit.
say_en.note: Claude checks CLI and initializes the project.
Claude enters the Constitution phase and generates constitution.md.

say_en.text: Generate implementation tasks for the current feature.
say_en.note: Claude enters the Tasks phase and creates tasks.md.
